current.label: Mid-Morning Pin
current.desc: Long gamma pulls price toward max-γ strike. Fade breakouts, target the pin.

next.label: Lunch Chop
next.desc: Volume drops. Dealer books partially hedged. No edge — wait for 1:15 re-engagement.

windows.label: Pre-Market
windows.desc: Overnight charm is accumulating unhedged. CHEX sign predicts open drift.

windows.label: Opening Drive
windows.desc: Vanna repricing dominates. IV collapse drives mechanical dealer hedging. First direction often reverses.

windows.label: Morning Reversal
windows.desc: Opening vanna + overnight charm unwind collide. Highest reversal probability of the session.

windows.label: Mid-Morning Pin
windows.desc: Long gamma pulls price toward max-γ strike. Fade breakouts, target the pin.

windows.label: Lunch Chop
windows.desc: Volume drops. Dealer books partially hedged. No edge — wait for 1:15 re-engagement.

windows.label: Pre-Power
windows.desc: Charm beginning to accelerate. Setup window — position before Dealer O'Clock.

windows.label: Dealer O'Clock
windows.desc: Dealers aggressively hedge the entire 0DTE book. Charm is ~2-3x morning rate. Moves accelerate in prevailing direction.

windows.label: Power Hour
windows.desc: Peak charm flow. OTM delta collapsing → dealers unwinding long hedges on calls, short hedges on puts.

windows.label: Settlement Games
windows.desc: SPX cash-settles at 4:00 ET. Dealers aggressively defend key strikes. Pin is strongest or breaks violently.

windows.label: After Hours
windows.desc: Session closed. Overnight charm begins accumulating for tomorrow.
